requirements.rule: APPRENTICESHIP under_classification (art. apprendistato professionalizzante CCNL Gomma e Plastica; rule from contratticcnl.it: the apprentice cannot be classified more than two levels below the destination). Track 'professionalizzante' for destinations G, F, E, D, C, B: 0-12 months two levels below, 12-24 one level below, then destination. The 12/12 boundaries are an approximation (no public monthly table). H (only one level below exists), I, A and Q are not modelled as destinations.
requirements.remediation: Source the monthly apprenticeship table and correct the 12/12 period boundaries.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour follows the national CCNL rule on the hours of a day of leave (art. 32 c. 1-bis D.Lgs. 151/2001, work_rules.parental_hourly), or without one the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter: half the average daily hours a day, two such days a day of leave, no cumulation with the nursing rests on the same day (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.1-2.2). The run records this limitation while the bundle does not record the rule of the CCNL; a company or territorial agreement is the fact local_hourly_agreement of the event.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: SICKNESS PAY BANDS (art. 39): 100% net for the first 3, 4 or 5 months by seniority (up to 3, up to 6, over 6 years), then 2/3 for 3, 5 or 7 months while INPS pays, 50% otherwise within the comporto; the file pays 100% for 180 days of an episode.
requirements.remediation: Model the 100%, 2/3 and 50% bands of art. 39 by seniority.
